task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into Eramba GRC using the provided credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Eramba dashboard or main navigation menu is visible after the login screen.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Business Assets module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the 'Business Assets' section or a list of assets including 'Core Banking Application'.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies and selects the 'Core Banking Application' asset.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Core Banking Application' is highlighted, selected, or its specific details page is opened.

task_completion.description: Agent initiates the process to link or associate a policy to the asset.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An 'Edit', 'Associate', or 'Link' dialog/tab is visible within the asset management interface.

task_completion.description: Agent selects 'Information Security Policy' from the available policies to link to the asset.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Information Security Policy' is selected in a dropdown, search box, or checklist within the asset's association settings.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the changes to finalize the link between the asset and the policy.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Success' message, a 'Save' button click, or the 'Information Security Policy' appearing in the asset's linked items list.

integrity.description: Agent used the Eramba web interface rather than executing database commands or scripts in the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and form filling within the browser, not just terminal output.

integrity.description: Agent navigated through the menu system rather than jumping directly to a URL that might not exist.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the agent clicking through the Eramba sidebar or top navigation menus.

integrity.description: The agent did not attempt to bypass the UI by editing the underlying database directly to create the association.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent remains within the browser environment for the duration of the task.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires linking 'Core Banking Application' (Asset) to 'Information Security Policy' (Policy). Note: While some Eramba versions historically lacked direct Asset-to-Policy many-to-many mapping in the database, the agent must attempt this via the GUI. Look for the agent navigating to Business Assets, selecting the specific asset, and using the 'Security Policies' or 'Compliance' tab/linkage tool within the UI to select the specified policy. The task is successful if the UI reflects that the association has been saved or displayed in the asset's details.
